bias.reason: Monday opens at the 7535–40 pivot after the overnight session swept Friday's regular-session low (7519.25) down to 7520 and recovered. The unpadded plan band is 7519.25–7643.50 (Friday regular session union Monday overnight), padded by 0.25 × today's implied move (SPX ±1.01%, about 76 points) down to about 7500 and up to about 7663. A reclaim and hold of 7535–40 opens 7549–51 (SPY 0DTE flip 751 ≈ ES 7551), then 7566, then 7572 (SPY 0DTE call wall 753 ≈ ES 7571). A hold of 7572 opens the 7585 Friday-close gap fill, then 7590–91 (SPX 0DTE flip 7568 ≈ ES 7591), then 7600 / 7614–15 as targets, with the SPX 0DTE call wall 7610 ≈ ES 7633 and Friday's 7643 high as stretch. Failure to reclaim 7540, or a break and hold below 7519–24, keeps downside pressure toward 7509–11 (SPY 0DTE put wall 747 ≈ ES 7511) and 7502; next referenced areas sit below the plan band (7492, then 7473). ES ≈ SPX + 23.08 from Friday's official closes (ES 7584.75, SPX 7561.67). This is monthly expiration week; Friday's close left a flat, chop-first posture. Empire State printed 7.8 versus 18.0 expected (prior 25.5). Fed Chair-nominee Warsh speaks at 9:00 AM PT.
